s1.title: 1. Purpose of processing
s1.body: VISA n JOB processes only the minimum personal information needed for job seeker registration, visa checks, consultation requests and hiring requests.

s2.title: 2. Items processed
s2.body: We process only the items shown on each screen, such as mobile number, name, nationality, visa type and preferred region and industry. We do not collect alien registration numbers or passport numbers at registration.

s3.title: 3. Retention period
s3.body: We delete the information without delay once the purpose is achieved or consent is withdrawn. If a law requires retention, we keep it for that period.

s4.title: 4. Provision to third parties
s4.body: Companies receive only blind information. Your real name is given only to the company concerned after you agree to an interview, and contact details are never given to companies.

s5.title: 5. Security measures
s5.body: Identifying information is stored encrypted, and staff access is logged.

s6.title: 6. Your rights
s6.body: You can request access, correction, deletion or suspension of processing, and withdraw consent at any time.

s7.title: 7. Contact
s7.body: For privacy questions, please contact us through our main phone.

s1.title: Article 1 Purpose
s1.body: These terms set the conditions for using the job brokerage and visa check services provided by VISA n JOB.

s2.title: Article 2 Services
s2.body: VISA n JOB provides job seeker registration, reference visa checks, hiring request intake, blind recommendations and interview arrangement.

s3.title: Article 3 No direct contact
s3.body: Contact between job seekers and companies goes through VISA n JOB only. Contact details are not exchanged within the service.

s4.title: Article 4 Fees
s4.body: No fees for job seekers. Employer fees follow the fees page and the contract.

s5.title: Article 5 Nature of results
s5.body: Visa check and score results are for reference only and must be confirmed by an administrative agent. A result does not mean a status permit will be granted.

s6.title: Article 6 User obligations
s6.body: Users must not register false information or use another person's information.

s7.title: Article 7 Changes to the terms
s7.body: When the terms change, we announce the effective date and the changes in advance.
